combo_label: The Sunday Roast × At the Funfair × Ancient Egypt

entries.clue: Flat-topped rectangular burial place of an early noble family
Month of the old London fair that gave a smart district its name
Feline protectress venerated with great cemeteries of cats
Slow-turning giant that stops with you stuck at the very top
Creamy-white root, sweeter than a carrot when its edges catch
Translucent white stone cut into vessels and lamps
Drum ride that pins you to the wall as the floor drops away
Cube of dried beef stock in red foil, on sale since 1910
Tradesman who bones, rolls and ties a joint to order
Of beef, still red in the middle - and the opposite of common
Ibis-headed patron of scribes and reckoning
Falcon-headed son who avenged his slain father to win the throne
Sticky red coating on a fairground apple
